listLede: Draft, publish, or unpublish brochure pages. The public site reads published pages when Pages is on.
editLede: Title, body, and SEO follow the locale files. The slug is shared. Save draft keeps it off the public site. Unpublish takes a live page down. Publish shows it at /locale/slug and stamps the published date and publisher.
slugHint: Shared across locales. about → /locale/about. home → /locale (site root).
tagsHint: Comma-separated. Stored on this pack’s page tags, not media tags.
metaTitleHint: Browser tab and search title. Falls back to the page title when empty.
metaDescriptionHint: Short summary for search results and link previews.
ogHint: Starforge media id. Shared across locales.
categoriesLede: Editorial labels for brochure pages. Assign one category on each page. Tags stay separate for free-form labels.
categoryConfirmDelete: Delete category “'{title}'”? Pages keep their content and become uncategorized.
categoryEmptyLede: Use Add + for an editorial label, then assign it on a page.
categorySlugHint: Filter key. Leave blank to build it from the title.
categoryAddHint: One category per page. Not the same as page tags.
tagsLede: Add here or type comma-separated names on a page. Click a tag to rename or delete.
tagConfirmDelete: Delete this tag? Pages keep their other tags.
versionsHint: Last 20 saves. Restore replaces the current page and keeps that current copy in this list.
versionConfirm: Restore this version? The current page is saved first.
versionEmpty: No saved versions yet. The next save starts the list.
